option_relations.rationale: Polymorphous light eruption is a condition that presents with an intensely pruritic skin eruption after sun exposure, matching the description of option A.

Polymorphic light eruption is another term for polymorphous light eruption, which is a condition that presents with an intensely pruritic skin eruption after sun exposure, matching the description of option B.

Juvenile spring eruption (JSE) associated with parvovirus B19 infection is a condition that presents with an intensely pruritic skin eruption after sun exposure, and the patient's symptoms and laboratory results match this diagnosis, matching the description of option C.

Parvovirus B19-associated photodermatitis is a subtype of juvenile spring eruption (JSE) associated with parvovirus B19 infection, as it presents with similar symptoms and is caused by the same virus, matching the description of option D.
